data.body: [P2] Approach: Document the warning-retention decision required by rule 7. The description promises one warning per session per execution environment, but this unlisted 1,000-session eviction policy permits an older session to warn again. The added cache test explicitly expects that behavior. Rule 7 requires independently chosen defaults and changed edge cases, with their reasons, in the PR description. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and settle the warning guarantee and retention policy explicitly.
